experiment: contrastive-pairing (CPF3: single-objective training on paired corrected data)
description: Trains RNN/LSTM/Transformer/Mamba on the PAIRED marked-reversal training set (languages/marked-reversal-fixed-contrastive) under the 'rec' objective, 10 trials each (40 runs), with --pair-id-file passed to train.py so batches respect pair boundaries. Evaluated on the standard FLaRe test set, the corrected test set, and pair-preserved accuracy on the 1261 reconstructed test-set pairs.
